title: 区域场景与条件分支（关卡救援与分支）（第 1／4 部分）

rows.source: You can take some meat, just don't tell anyone...
rows.current: * 你可以拿些肉，只是别告诉任何人……

rows.source: Bye bye, come back with lots of lect!
rows.current: * 拜拜，下次带一大堆 lect 回来啊！

rows.source: Bye bye, pup. Come back when you're older!
rows.current: * 拜拜，小狗。等你长大点再来吧！

rows.source: Hmm... twenty five years old. Looks legitimate.
rows.current: * 嗯……二十五岁。看起来没问题。

rows.source: Alright, can I get you something?
rows.current: * 好了，要我给你来点什么吗？

rows.source: Hmm... twenty one years old. Looks legitimate.
rows.current: * 嗯……二十一岁。看起来没问题。

rows.source: Alright, can I get you something?
rows.current: * 好了，要我给你来点什么吗？

rows.source: Welcome! Hot meats, cool treats! Perfect for Ayskammr!
rows.current: * 欢迎！热腾腾的肉，冰凉凉的甜点！正适合艾斯卡姆尔！

rows.source: It's my special recipe! The tastiest, coolest drink on this planet!
rows.current: * 这是我的独家配方！全星球最美味、最沁凉的饮料！

rows.source: This stuff will quench your thirst and recover some PSY, but to be honest...
rows.current: * 这玩意儿能解渴，还能恢复一些精神力，不过说实话……

rows.source: ...it won't cool you down like a nice ICECOLA will!
rows.current: * ……可它没法像爽口的 ICECOLA 那样让你凉快下来！

rows.source: Carved from ferocious beasties, slow roasted over lava! Restores vitality!
rows.current: * 取自凶猛野兽的肉，在熔岩上慢火烤成！恢复活力！

rows.source: Good luck with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外头热得很，祝你一路顺利！

rows.source: Take care with the heat out there!
rows.current: * 外头这么热，多当心！

rows.source: Wish I could go out and get a nice ICECOLA to beat this heat. Whew!
rows.current: * 真希望能出去弄瓶上好的 ICECOLA 来压压这暑气。呼！

rows.source: Sorry! It's too hot to do any business down here!
rows.current: * 抱歉！这下面太热了，什么生意都做不了！

rows.source: I can't count money properly until I'm cooled off, ya know?
rows.current: * 不凉快下来，我连钱都数不清，懂吧？

rows.source: It's way too hot down here! There's a save point just north of here
rows.current: * 这下面实在太热了！如果你需要地方休息，这儿的正北方就有个存档点。我甚至在房间下方立了块牌子，不会错过的！

rows.source: if you need a place to rest. I even put a sign under the room, can't miss it!
It's way too hot down here! There's a save point just north of here
rows.current: * 这下面热死了！要休息的话，往北走就有个存档点。我还在房间下面放了牌子，不会错过的！

rows.source: if you need a place to rest. I even put a sign under the room, can't miss it!
Wanna become a space pirate? All you need is this Official Pirate Lighttazer!
rows.current: * 想当太空海盗吗？你需要的只是这把官方海盗光电击器！

rows.source: Plus a ship and a crew of outlaws, of course!
rows.current: * 当然，还得有一艘飞船和一群亡命之徒！

rows.source: ...just don't forget to equip it, it's not just for show, ya know.
rows.current: * ……只是别忘了把它装备上，它可不是摆设，懂吧？

rows.source: Ahhh that's the stuff! Good and strong!
rows.current: * 啊——就是这个味儿！够劲，够浓！

rows.source: I can finally stop being toasty and do some business!
rows.current: * 我终于不用再热得发烫，可以做点生意了！

rows.source: Ahhh that's the stuff! Good and strong!
rows.current: * 啊，就是这个味儿！真够劲！

rows.source: I can finally stop being toasty and do some business!
rows.current: * 总算不用烤得冒烟，可以做生意了！

rows.source: Ahhh that's the stuff! Good and strong!
rows.current: * 啊，就是这个味儿！真够劲！

rows.source: I can finally stop being toasty and do some business!
rows.current: * 总算不用烤得冒烟，可以做生意了！

rows.source: Carved from ferocious beasties, slow roasted over lava! Restores vitality!
rows.current: * 取自凶猛野兽的肉，在熔岩上慢火烤成！恢复活力！

rows.source: In fact, it's almost too hot to handle... YEOWCH!
rows.current: * 事实上，它烫得几乎没法上手……哎哟！

rows.source: Th-thanks pal, I don't know how you non-tops do it...!
rows.current: * 谢、谢谢你，伙计。真不知道你们不当攻的都是怎么熬过来的……！

rows.source: Please come back soon!
rows.current: * 请早点回来！

rows.source: If you could, like, come back with a key, that'd be cool!!
rows.current: * 要是你能，那个，带把钥匙回来，那就太酷了！！

rows.source: There's no way to trap this guy w-without a key! Hurry up and get one p-please!
rows.current: * 没有钥匙根本没法困住这家伙！快、快去弄一把，求你了！

rows.source: There's no way to open this cell w-without a key! Hurry up and get one p-please!
rows.current: * 没钥匙就打、打不开牢房！拜、拜托你快去找一把！

rows.source: Oh! Miracle!
rows.current: * 哦！奇迹！

rows.source: Uhn... teasin' me like that... It's making me even HOTTER!
rows.current: * 唔嗯……这样逗我……只会让我更热啊！

rows.source: No way...! I'm never gonna get out of here at this rate!
rows.current: * 不会吧……！这样下去，我永远都出不去了！

rows.source: Hmf... good luck out there.
rows.current: * 哼……祝你在外面好运。

rows.source: Bye bye. If you wanna help, go sniff me out a MAN!
rows.current: * 拜拜啦。你要是真想帮忙，就去给我嗅个男人回来！

rows.source: Lead your master back here, please!
rows.current: * 请把你的主人带到这里来！

rows.source: Well you aren't the person I was wanting to see!
rows.current: * 哎，你可不是我想见的那个人呀！

rows.source: Oh, it's a dog!
rows.current: * 哦，是只狗！

rows.source: Look at how I'm riding this tazer hilt. That could be your cock, big boy!
rows.current: * 看看我怎么骑着这电击枪柄。换成你的鸡巴就好了，猛男！

rows.source: Come here and give it to me!
rows.current: * 过来，狠狠干我！

rows.source: I don't usually swing that way, but for you I'll make an exception...
rows.current: * 我平时不好这一口，但对你，我愿意破例……

rows.source: Ohmigod just give me some RELIEF!
rows.current: * 天呐，你就让我舒服一下吧！

rows.source: Grrrr...! Less talk and more POUNDING. ME. LIKE. STEEL!
rows.current: * 咕噜噜……！少废话，像打铁一样！狠狠！干！我！

rows.source: Get me a MAN, come on!
rows.current: * 快给我找个男人来！

rows.source: It's an energy barrier, nothing complicated.
rows.current: * 就是道能量屏障，没什么复杂的。

rows.source: No offense, but you look a bit weak to break it yourself.
rows.current: * 无意冒犯，不过看你这样子，恐怕没力气自己打破它。

rows.source: Please come back soon with your master, and a key!
rows.current: * 请早点带着你的主人和一把钥匙回来！

rows.source: Take it easy out there, you hear?
rows.current: * 在外面多保重，听到没？

rows.source: Aww rats, it's just a dog.
rows.current: * 唉，真扫兴，只是条狗啊。

rows.source: Can you get your master to come back with a key? I'm locked up in here!
rows.current: * 你能让你的主人带着钥匙回来吗？我被锁在这里面了！

rows.source: I've... already tried picking the lock. I'm afraid you'll have to find a key...
rows.current: * 我……已经试过撬锁了。恐怕你得去找把钥匙……

rows.source: W-wow! Thanks! You know, dogs really are n-nice, haha...
rows.current: * 哇、哇！谢谢！狗狗真的很、很好，哈哈……

rows.source: I bet I could give you a nice reward, huh...? How about it?
rows.current: * 我该能给你点不错的奖励吧……？怎么样？

rows.source: ...you know that wasn't attached to me, right?
rows.current: * ……你知道那东西可不是长在我身上的吧？

rows.source: I... I think I can take it from here.
rows.current: * 我……我想接下来我自己能行了。

rows.source: Bye bye! Come back with lots of Lect!
rows.current: * 再见啦！下次记得多带点Lect来！

rows.source: Hello! Can I get you something?
rows.current: * 你好！想买点什么？

rows.source: Gee, this would go real well with a gi, wouldn't it?
rows.current: * 哎呀，这玩意儿配道服正合适，不是吗？

rows.source: Why, who even needs a tazer when you'd be kitted out like that!
rows.current: * 哎呀，你这身装备还用得着电击枪吗！

rows.source: A real live psy crystal, just like those espers use!
rows.current: * 货真价实的精神力水晶，跟那些超能力者用的一样！

rows.source: You look like a smart dog, real bright eyes, cold wet nose, fluffy raised tail...
rows.current: * 你看着是只聪明的狗，眼睛亮晶晶的，鼻子又凉又湿，毛茸茸的尾巴翘得高高的……

rows.source: Did you know that ferals, are able to dig up dirt by pressing DOWN+ATTACK?
rows.current: * 你知道吗，野兽形态下按DOWN+攻击就能刨土！

rows.source: It's just good info to know, ya know!
rows.current: * 这可是实用的小知识，记着没坏处！

rows.source: It's just one crazy rumor after another out here, I tell ya.
rows.current: * 跟你说，这儿的离谱传闻真是一个接一个。

rows.source: Somebody was telling me that they saw a Werehund in the lower levels, even.
rows.current: * 甚至有人跟我说，在下层看见了一只狼犬。

rows.source: I've heard rumors of Espers running around nowadays! Ridiculous!
rows.current: * 听说最近有超能力者四处活动！真是荒唐！

rows.source: They say some can even shoot energy to hit switches from far away, bah!
rows.current: * 还说有些能发射能量，隔着老远打中开关，呸！

rows.source: Nothing like a nice bone to satisfy your craving!
rows.current: * 没有比一根好骨头更能解馋的了！

rows.source: Gives you a bit of vigor, too!
rows.current: * 还能让你添点儿活力！

rows.source: Oh hi, it's pretty rare to get visitors here!
rows.current: * 哦，你好，这儿可难得有客人来！

rows.source: Didn't you hear me? There's nothing left!
rows.current: * 你没听见我说话吗？什么都没剩下了！

rows.source: Go be greedy somewhere else!
rows.current: * 要贪心去别处贪去！

rows.source: Grrrr.... some folks are just absolutely SHAMELESS!
rows.current: * 呜……有些家伙简直太不要脸了！

rows.source: Why don't you just take EVERYTHING you can get your hands on? Huh?
rows.current: * 你怎么不干脆把能拿到的东西全拿走啊？嗯？

rows.source: Go on, do it! GEKKYZAA!!!!
rows.current: * 来啊，拿啊！GEKKYZAA!!!!

rows.source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
rows.current: * 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

rows.source: You're kinda early! Come back later and we can chat and drink, alright?
rows.current: * 你来得有点早！晚点再来，咱们喝点东西聊聊天，好吗？

rows.source: Well! That last quake just wrecked my whole supply!
rows.current: * 唉！上次地震把我的存货全毁了！

rows.source: I'll tell you what though, you seem like you're a good strong pupper.
rows.current: * 不过说真的，你看着是只挺棒又壮实的狗狗。

rows.source: Another one of you cosmofellas came by muttering that they left
rows.current: * 之前还来过一个跟你一样的太空伙计，嘴里嘀咕着说把武器落在这儿正北边了！

rows.source: their weapon just north of here!
"Bottom, middle, middle, top..." is what they kept saying, whatever that means!
rows.current: * 那家伙一直念叨着"下、中、中、上……"，谁知道是什么意思！

rows.source: If nobody's claimed that ol' weapon yet, it's as good as yours, I say! Take it!
rows.current: * 要是那把旧武器还没人认领，我说就归你了！拿去吧！

rows.source: Great idea! I'll just continue with this field work!
rows.current: * 好主意！那我就继续干这份野外工作啦！

rows.source: It's not like I *need* your help... well, probably not.
rows.current: * 我又不是*需要*你帮忙……好吧，大概不需要。

rows.source: G-good boy! Come back with your master!
rows.current: * 好、好孩子！快跟你主人回来！

rows.source: W-wait! Come back!
rows.current: * 等、等一下！回来呀！

rows.source: Oh hi there! I haven't seen another agent in weeks!
rows.current: * 哦，你好呀！我好几周没见别的特工了！

rows.source: Huh? Oh. It's just a dog.
rows.current: * 嗯？哦。原来只是只狗。

rows.source: I guess you can't help me get out of here, huh girl?
rows.current: * 你大概没法帮我出去吧，小姑娘？

rows.source: Wow! Thanks a lot!
rows.current: * 哇！太感谢了！

rows.source: Huh, r-rescue? Well I guess if you *have* to.
rows.current: * 啊，救、救我？既然你*非得*这样的话，那好吧。

rows.source: I've been embedded with a group of the local fauna these past few weeks.
rows.current: * 最近几周，我一直混在当地那群生物当中。

rows.source: Some real in-depth field work, if ya catch my drift!
rows.current: * 那可真是“深入”的实地考察，懂我意思吧！

rows.source: I'm - anh! - trying to subdue this Barker.
rows.current: * 我正——啊！——想制服这只吠犬。

rows.source: But he's a little more rowdy than I expected!
rows.current: * 但他比我想的要闹腾点！

rows.source: How useless...
rows.current: * 真没用……

rows.source: C-c'mon, you've *got* to get me out of here!
rows.current: * 快、快点，你*必须*把我从这里弄出去！

rows.source: I c-aah...can't take much moooore!
rows.current: * 我、啊……撑不了多——久——了！

rows.source: Please help me, good girl! You just gotta find someone...
rows.current: * 帮帮我，乖姑娘！你只要去找个人来……

rows.source: Thank you Yiffany! Thank you!
rows.current: * 谢谢你，伊吠妮！谢谢你！

rows.source: Please unlock my cell! Let me go free!
rows.current: * 求你打开牢门！放我自由吧！

rows.source: I'm fine now. Just... need a minute to catch my breath.
rows.current: * 我现在没事了。只是……得缓口气。

rows.source: Your assistance is no longer needed, rookie.
rows.current: * 不需要你的协助了，菜鸟。

rows.source: Scram, mutt! Get back in the cage!
rows.current: * 滚开，杂种狗！滚回笼子里去！

rows.source: This ain't a peepshow, punk! Show me the lect or get out!
rows.current: * 这儿不是给你白看的，混蛋！掏LECT，不然滚！

rows.source: All the cosmo-junk I sell has a story behind it.
rows.current: * 我卖的每件宇宙破烂背后都有故事。

rows.source: Reeeall good stories, heh-heh...
rows.current: * 那可都是绝——妙的故事，嘿嘿……

rows.source: This here? One of them tazers those cute lil spacebrats carry around.
rows.current: * 这个？就是那些可爱的太空小混蛋随身带的电击枪。

rows.source: A real primo, high end model too... except it's broken.
rows.current: * 还是顶级的高端型号呢……只可惜坏了。

rows.source: But the scrap alone will go for a thousand lect, off world. How about it?
rows.current: * 可光卖废料，拿到外星都能卖一千LECT。怎么样？

rows.source: Rawr! Come right on in, but only if you have plenty of Lect on you! Rawr!
rows.current: * 嗷！尽管进来，不过身上得带够Lect才行！嗷！

rows.source: Look I know it's hard to believe, but I'm not actually a Kobold pirate!
rows.current: * 听着，我知道这很难相信，但我其实不是科博德海盗！

rows.source: It's true! But if you want a disguise as good as mine, you can buy this.
rows.current: * 真的！不过你要是想弄一身跟我一样好的伪装，可以买这个。

rows.source: You'll need the full set in order to fool folks, but trust me...
rows.current: * 想骗过别人，你得凑齐一整套，不过相信我……

rows.source: ...it's the only way to get the GOOD goods from the slavers, hehe!
rows.current: * ……这是从奴隶贩子那儿弄到「好货」的唯一办法，嘿嘿！

rows.source: Plus, I'll throw in a map to the other disguise parts too!
rows.current: * 另外，我还会顺带送你一张标注其他伪装部件的地图！

rows.source: I know I look like a Space Pirate, but I'm really just a dog like you!
rows.current: * 我知道自己像太空海盗，但我跟你一样只是条狗！

rows.source: If you get a full set of Kobo gear, you could fool people too.
rows.current: * 要是弄到一整套科博装备，你也能骗过别人。

rows.source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
rows.current: * 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

rows.source: Is that a flashlight in your hands, or are you just happy to see me?
rows.current: * 你手里那是手电筒，还是见了我太兴奋了？

rows.source: I kid! I kid! You and that torch are lifesavers.
rows.current: * 逗你的，逗你的！你和那把手电筒可真是救星。

rows.source: Is that a flashlight in your hands, or are you just happy to see me?
rows.current: * 你手里那根是手电筒，还是见到我就兴奋得翘起来了？

rows.source: I kid! I kid! You and that torch are lifesavers.
rows.current: * 开玩笑！开玩笑！你和那支手电筒可是救星。

rows.source: Oh hey! Sorry, I didn't see you come in there.
rows.current: * 哦嘿！抱歉，我没看见你走进来。

rows.source: ...in fact, I can't see anything! It's too dark!
rows.current: * ……其实我什么都看不见！这里太黑了！

rows.source: This is just my luck, isn't it?
rows.current: * 我的运气还真是好啊，是吧？

rows.source: First somewan stole my hookshot so I have to walk around on these tiny legs...
rows.current: * 先是有人偷了我的钩索，害我只能靠这两条小短腿走路……

rows.source: ...and now the power is out and my flashlight is missing! Bah!
rows.current: * ……而现在又停电了，手电筒也不见了！哼！

rows.source: It's been getting ruffer and ruffer to do business around these parts, let me tell ya.
rows.current: * 跟你说吧，在这一带做生意是越来越难了。

rows.source: Earthquakes happen every other hour and the monsters are rowdier than ever...
rows.current: * 隔一个小时就地震一次，魔物也比以前更闹腾了……

rows.source: ...it almost feels like things are building up to something!
rows.current: * ……总觉得好像有什么大事要发生了！

rows.source: So anyways, you ever wear an Elven dress before? You look like the sort!
rows.current: * 话说回来，你以前穿过精灵连衣裙吗？你看着就像会穿的！

rows.source: Rumors say they prevent blocks from crumbling beneath your feet
rows.current: * 听说它们靠的是什么纳米机器，能防止脚下的方块崩塌……

rows.source: thanks to some sort of nano machines...
...but I think it's actually just magic!
rows.current: * ……不过我觉得其实就是魔法！

rows.source: This is a pretty little elven letter opener, if I do say so myself!
rows.current: * 要我自己说，这可是一把精巧的精灵拆信刀！

rows.source: Feather light, just like how those dresses the elves craft will make you feel.
rows.current: * 轻得像羽毛，就跟穿上精灵缝的裙子一样轻盈。

rows.source: ...not that I would know anything about those!
rows.current: * ……当然，那些裙子我可一点都不了解！

rows.source: P-please! I'm real desperate-like!
rows.current: * 求、求你了！我可真是急得不行了！

rows.source: Quit fooling around and bust me out of here. Don't make me say it twice.
rows.current: * 别磨蹭了，把我从这里弄出去。别让我说第二遍。

rows.source: Good doggy! Bring back help!
rows.current: * 好狗狗！快去找帮手回来！

rows.source: Hmf, just my luck...
rows.current: * 哼，我这是什么运气……

rows.source: Dang, just a dog.
rows.current: * 啧，只是只狗。

rows.source: Guess'n you can't help me yerself, doggy... so are you gonna get somebody who can?
rows.current: * 看来你自己帮不了我，小狗狗……那你能去找个帮得上忙的人来吗？

rows.source: Aaa! Thankyah! My legs... my dick...! Y-you won't believe how desperate I was!
rows.current: * 啊啊！谢啦！我的腿……我的鸡巴……！你、你不会信我刚才有多急！

rows.source: A fine sortie, all told, but I'm hankerin' for a bit of R and R after this!
rows.current: * 这一趟出击总体打得不错，不过之后我可真盼着能歇上一歇！
